visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white oversized T-shirt with a graphic of a boy, sits on a cream-colored couch. She holds two small rectangular electric shavers (one silver, one dark grey) near her face, smiling broadly and speaking directly to the camera. The background is a simple grey curtain. (2) A transition occurs to a static graphic slide with a white background, displaying the MOZTECH x OLiBear logo and a list of technical specifications in Chinese, including weight, sound level, material, and charging input. (3) The scene shifts back to real-world footage, showing close-ups of the shavers' packaging and the units themselves. The devices have a metallic finish on top and a translucent bottom part. (4) A young man with a black baseball cap and a gold chain is shown indoors. The woman uses the silver mini shaver on his neck. (5) An extreme close-up focuses on the man's lower face as he uses the shaver on his cheek and upper lip, highlighting the skin contact and the device's size. (6) The woman is seen in a mirror reflection, holding the shavers and pointing to her phone, which is partially visible. (7) A hand places the dark grey shaver into a small front pocket of a blue canvas bag labeled with 'Tue'. (8) The shaver is shown connected to a pink power bank via a white Type-C cable; a blue circular icon with a white mountain silhouette lights up on the device's surface. (9) The shaver is submerged in a clear plastic cup of water and then dropped into a white porcelain sink with running water, demonstrating its waterproof capability. (10) The man uses a different attachment on the same device to trim his nose hair. (11) The woman returns to her initial position on the couch, gesturing energetically with the shavers while smiling and making various facial expressions. (12) The final section consists of several fast-paced graphic slides detailing product features like the 7200rpm motor, German steel blades, and IPX7 rating using icons and text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female narration begins over a bright, high-energy electronic pop BGM with a clear, synthetic 4-on-the-floor beat. The vocal is crisp and professionally captured. (2) As technical specs are visually introduced, the narrator maintains an upbeat speech rate, clearly articulating product names. (3) A faint mechanical hum of the shaver motor is briefly heard, layered under the narration and music. (4) The audio shifts into a more conversational but still energetic narrative mode, with frequent editing cuts that synchronize with visual changes. (5) A clear sound of water splashing and liquid movement is heard during the waterproof demonstration. (6) The narrator's pitch rises during the final CTA for 'Father's Day', accompanied by a slight swell in the BGM volume before a sharp cut at the video's end.
